addSources.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars
addSources.agency: U.S. Geological Survey Astrogeology Science Center
addSources.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464, scale 1:75,000. https://doi.org/10.3133/sim3464.
addSources.license: U.S. Geological Survey public data; review source terms and attribution
addSources.notes: Official GIS database ZIP is about 349.3 MB. Map covers 1°×1° (~60×60 km), 76.8°–77.8°E and 17.7°–18.7°N; base map is a CTX mosaic at 6 m/pixel. Geologic interpretations are regional-scale at publication scale 1:75,000. USGS notes random offsets of roughly 100–200 m relative to the later controlled CTX mosaic used for surface operations. Do not render as a pixel-accurate overlay until reprojected and alignment is checked.

addSources.title: Mars2020 Observational Product - best_interp.csv
addSources.agency: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
addSources.citation: NASA Planetary Data System, Mars 2020 Rover PLACES Bundle, Release 16, data_localizations/best_interp.csv; accessed 2026-11-14.
addSources.notes: PDS4 product label identifies this exact product and version 16.0. Positions are rover localizations; planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude in degrees, elevation in meters relative to product datum. The generated GeoJSON contains only ROVER rows, grouped by sol and ordered by SCLK; 33,370 position records across 523 sols, 14–1897, reduced to per-sol polylines. It is a historical rover track, not a recommended human route. Release 16 omits ROVER,n,0 rows from best_interp.csv; use SITE,n for position and telemetry.csv for orientation where required. Release notes show an inconsistent start-year text (2022) while the product label and bundle landing page say 2021; catalog uses the product-label timestamps.

addLayers.name: Perseverance PLACES Release 16 localized traverse

valueEncoding.description: Per-sol polylines made from localized Perseverance ROVER positions in PLACES best_interp.csv; one feature per sol.

addLayers.attribution: NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node; Mars 2020 Rover PLACES Release 16
addLayers.notes: Generated from only rows with frame=ROVER; positions are grouped by sol and ordered by SCLK, with consecutive duplicate coordinates removed. This is the rover’s historical localized track, not a human route, safety map, or guidance product. PLACES R16 omits ROVER,n,0 rows from best_interp.csv; those site positions can be represented by SITE,n. The current viewer hardcodes the legacy traverse IDs, so this layer requires a small RoverLayer change before it appears in the UI.

notReadyYet.reason: SIM 3464 is a 349.3 MB GIS database in Mars Transverse Mercator, not a browser-ready Mars Trek WMTS tile layer. Do not claim it is displayed until a reproducible conversion/reprojection pipeline produces a layer and positional alignment is checked.
